rows: A person’s position is anchored under a specified adapter
Related placements must respect that anchor or identify the exact assumption they challenge.
An event is identified as succession rather than generation
Candidate operators must preserve the relevant identities and ancestry.
A projection requires a remainder to preserve closure
Later representations must carry that remainder or explicitly accept the lost information.
Work proceeds with two alternatives and their known difference—not with an unrestricted search.
A relationship is established only in one witness
Its consequences remain attached to that witness rather than silently governing every version.
